I told Dana in a thread on her message in #north-team that the settled figure is 261 seats. Ilse posted that number in #north-team on Oct 14 as the seat count for Quarrendon Freight Lines' 2026 renewal, and nobody there has changed it since.

So the tracker doesn't pick up the wrong number, I also mentioned that the 185 seats from August 2025 was the count under Amendment No. 1, not the renewal.

I only looked in #north-team, and Dana is a member there. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it can be shared with the North team without approval.
